title: The Lost Frequency — EN/JA/ZH (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 94bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic lost signal Japanese Chinese language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
There is a frequency that no one's broadcasting on right now
It used to carry a voice that I knew how
To find at half past nine on a Tuesday after dark
The lost frequency still lives inside the tuning's mark

[Verse 2 — Japanese, with English translation]
失われた周波数は今も存在している
[The lost frequency still exists even now]
かつてそこに声があった、今は静かに眠っている
[Once there was a voice there, now it sleeps quietly]
ダイアルを端から端まで回しても見つからない
[Even scanning the dial end to end, it cannot be found]
失われた周波数は大気の中に隠れている
[The lost frequency is hidden in the atmosphere]

[Chorus — English]
The lost frequency, the lost frequency
It carried something I was meant to hear
The lost frequency, the lost frequency
Its signal's somewhere in the atmosphere
It moved, it changed, it stepped outside the band
The lost frequency is still transmitting somewhere — and
I'm still trying to receive it with my hand
That's my boy

[Bridge — Chinese Mandarin, with English translation]
失去的频率依然在某处传播
[The lost frequency is still broadcasting somewhere]
它曾经携带着我需要听到的声音
[It once carried the sound I needed to hear]
拨盘从头到尾扫描，却找不到它
[Scanning the dial end to end, I cannot find it]
失去的频率在大气层中等待着
[The lost frequency is waiting in the atmosphere]

[Outro — All three languages]
Lost frequency… 失われた周波数… 失去的频率
Still transmitting — まだ送信中 — 仍在传播
That's my boy
